messages.content:
Instance SearXNG auto-hebergee (Docker, image searxng/searxng), utilisee comme
moteur de recherche d'un assistant vocal local. Elle est interrogee en JSON par
GET /search?q=...&format=json depuis un conteneur voisin.

PANNE CONSTATEE le 2026-09-20 : HTTP 200 mais `results: []` et
`number_of_results: 0` sur des requetes factuelles (« meteo Marseille »).
Le champ `unresponsive_engines` rend :

  [["duckduckgo","CAPTCHA"], ["mojeek","Suspended: access denied"],
   ["startpage","Suspended: CAPTCHA"], ["wolframalpha","timeout"],
   ["yep","Suspended: access denied"]]

Une requete generique (« python ») rend bien 11 resultats. « Marseille » rend
`results: []` mais une infobox Wikipedia.

CONFIGURATION COMPLETE ACTUELLE (settings.yml, secrets masques) :

```yaml
general:
  debug: false
  instance_name: "Atlas_Search"
  privacypolicy_url: false
  donation_url: false
  contact_url: false
  enable_metrics: true
  open_metrics: ''

brand:
  new_issue_url: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/issues/new
  docs_url: https://docs.searxng.org/
  public_instances: https://searx.space
  wiki_url: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/wiki
  issue_url: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/issues

search:
  safe_search: 0
  autocomplete: ""
  autocomplete_min: 4
  favicon_resolver: ""
  default_lang: "auto"
  ban_time_on_fail: 5
  max_ban_time_on_fail: 120
  suspended_times:
    SearxEngineAccessDenied: 86400
    SearxEngineCaptcha: 86400
    SearxEngineTooManyRequests: 3600
    cf_SearxEngineCaptcha: 1296000
    cf_SearxEngineAccessDenied: 86400
    recaptcha_SearxEngineCaptcha: 604800
  formats:
    - html
    - json

server:
  port: 8080
  bind_address: "127.0.0.1"
  base_url: false
  limiter: true
  public_instance: false
  secret_key: <masque>
  image_proxy: false
  http_protocol_version: "1.0"
  method: "POST"
  default_http_headers:
    X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
    X-Download-Options: noopen
    X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow
    Referrer-Policy: no-referrer

limiter:
  enable: true
  rate: 10
  burst: 30

valkey:
  url: false

ui:
  static_path: ""
  templates_path: ""
  query_in_title: false
  default_theme: simple
  center_alignment: false
  default_locale: ""
  theme_args:
    simple_style: auto
  search_on_category_select: true
  hotkeys: default
  url_formatting: pretty

outgoing:
  request_timeout: 3.0
  useragent_suffix: ""
  pool_connections: 100
  pool_maxsize: 20
  enable_http2: true

plugins:
  searx.plugins.calculator.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.hash_plugin.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.self_info.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.unit_converter.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.ahmia_filter.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.hostnames.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.time_zone.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true
  searx.plugins.tracker_url_remover.SXNGPlugin:
    active: true

checker:
  off_when_debug: true

categories_as_tabs:
  general:
  images:
  videos:
  news:
  map:
  music:
  it:
  science:
  files:
  social media:

engines:
  - name: google
    engine: google
    shortcut: go
  - name: google images
    engine: google_images
    shortcut: goi
  - name: duckduckgo
    engine: duckduckgo
    shortcut: ddg
  - name: wikipedia
    engine: wikipedia
    shortcut: wp
    display_type: ["infobox"]
  - name: github
    engine: github
    shortcut: gh
  - name: wikidata
    engine: wikidata
    shortcut: wd
    display_type: ["infobox"]
  - name: reddit
    engine: reddit
    shortcut: re
  - name: arxiv
    engine: arxiv
    shortcut: arx
  - name: startpage
    engine: startpage
    shortcut: sp
  - name: qwant
    engine: qwant
    shortcut: qw
  - name: mojeek
    engine: mojeek
    shortcut: mjk
  - name: yep
    engine: yep
    shortcut: yep
  - name: pypi
    engine: pypi
    shortcut: pypi
  - name: npm
    engine: npm
    shortcut: npm
  - name: docker hub
    engine: docker_hub
    shortcut: dh
  - name: stack overflow
    engine: stackexchange
    shortcut: st
  - name: osm
    engine: openstreetmap
    shortcut: osm
  - name: youtube
    engine: youtube_noapi
    shortcut: yt
  - name: wolframalpha
    engine: wolframalpha_noapi
    shortcut: wa
  - name: hackernews
    engine: hackernews
    shortcut: hn
  - name: dailymotion
    engine: dailymotion
    shortcut: dm

doi_resolvers:
  oadoi.org: 'https://oadoi.org/'
  doi.org: 'https://doi.org/'

default_doi_resolver: 'oadoi.org'
```

TA MISSION — ANGLE « MOTEURS »
Tu es expert SearXNG. Recommande la MEILLEURE SELECTION DE MOTEURS pour cette
instance : auto-hebergee, faible trafic, IP residentielle, questions FACTUELLES
et FRAICHES en francais (meteo, actualite, horaires, definitions, conversions).

Sections :
1. DIAGNOSTIC : pourquoi ces cinq moteurs tombent, pourquoi google et qwant
   survivent. Ce qui distingue un moteur robuste d'un moteur fragile.
2. MOTEURS A RETIRER, avec la raison.
3. MOTEURS A AJOUTER : bloc YAML exact pret a coller dans `engines:`. Aucun
   moteur demandant une cle ou un compte. Pense francophone et specialise.
4. METEO : quel moteur ou plugin repond a « meteo Marseille » ? C'est le cas
   d'usage qui a echoue, sois concret.
5. VERIFICATION : commandes curl exactes.

Pas de preambule. Precis et actionnable.
